newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Heaven seals CNA deal, sees more.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Heaven seals CNA deal, sees more.

text.p: South African confectioner Sweets From Heaven Ltd said on Wednesday that it had sealed it tie-up with leisure firm and retailer CNA Gallo Ltd.
The deal, first mooted last September, will see Heaven franchise its outlets within CNA branches and Nu Metro cinema complexes throughout South Africa.
CNA will also take at least a 25 percent stake in the sweet firm.
The price-tag for the franchise is 9.15 million rand, which will be settled by the issue to CNA of 9.15 million Heaven shares at one rand each.

CNA will also subscribe for additional Heaven shares to bring its stake up to the required level of at least 25 percent. To facilitate this and raise extra cash for growth, Heaven is making a rights offer on the basis of 28 new shares for every 100 held at an issue price of 198 cents.
This will raise a maximum before expenses of 31.85 million rand and CNA will buy 9.3 million of the 16.1 million new shares.
The firm said it could not give any growth forecasts resulting from the deal, but added that it was already looking at other expansion opportunities.
"(Heaven) is already back at the negotiating table," the firm said.
